parameters: \rZinnia: So you came for me.\nThanks for that.
\rThat's really good, \PN.\nI really feel it, right here.
Could add text where Zinnia teases the player
for forgetting where Sky Pillar is
\rSince you've been a good boy, I think\nI'll give you something I've been keeping.
\rSince you've been a good girl, I think\nI'll give you something I've been keeping.
\rThe paintings that cover the walls of this tower…
\rSee, these are the history of humanity, of Pokémon, and of nature itself.
\rThey're the tales that have been passed down by my ancestors, the Draconids, for thousands of years.
\rAnd now…I will pass that history and lore on to you.
\rThousands of years ago, in the primal age long lost, the world was overflowing with natural energy.
\rPrimal Groudon and Primal Kyogre fought over that energy in endless, furious clashes.
\rIn the face of Primal Groudon and Kyogre's great power, people could do nothing.
\rThe only choice was to watch as disaster upon disaster swept over them.
\rIt was in such a time that a great many meteoroids poured from the darkness of space, from a place higher even than the heavens.
\rAnd the meteoroids fell in their multitude upon a waterfall that had long been home to a tribe of Dragon-type-Pokémon users…
\rThat's the end of the first chapter of my tale.
\rI'll tell you the next part of the story on the next floor. Look forward to it!
